english.title: Club Secretary fail to produce club certificate to licensing authority within 14 days - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the secretary of a club, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE CLUB..), which held a club premises certificate for registered premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE REGISTERED ADDRESS..), failed, without reasonable excuse, to produce to the licensing authority, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LICENSING AUTHORITY..), within fourteen days of receipt of a request, the certificate in respect of those premises in order that the licensing authority could discharge its obligations under Part 4 of the Licensing Act 2003
english.legislation: Contrary to section 93 of the Licensing Act 2003.
